IGUI_TWA_ReqForgePrimitive: Requires a primitive forge or better
IGUI_TWA_ReqForgeNormal: Requires a normal forge or better
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_Cancel: Give up on this recipe: WIPES every procedure already marked done for it (their materials are still not refunded) and goes back to the recipe list. Takes real time, and can be aborted before it finishes if you change your mind.
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_Finish: Complete the recipe and get the item. Requires the base item and every listed procedure done first. The procedures' quality words are averaged into the item's overall quality, which decides the pool its grade is rolled from.
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_AbortAction: Stop whatever is currently running (Cancel/Incomplete/Finish) before it finishes. Since it hasn't completed yet, nothing happens -- everything stays exactly as it was.
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_ConfirmProcedure: Start the selected procedure: play its minigame, then the procedure runs and uses up its materials whatever the score - a Miss (or cancelling the minigame) still uses them but leaves the procedure undone, so it can be tried again. Being interrupted after the minigame, before the procedure finishes, costs nothing.
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_CancelProcedure: Stop the procedure currently in progress. Since it hasn't finished, no materials are consumed.
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_FilterAvailable: Show only recipes you already have the base item for right now.
IGUI_TWA_SelectRecipeFirst: Select a recipe on the left first
IGUI_TWA_SelectProcedureFirst: Click a procedure above to see its requirements
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_Incomplete: Bookmark your progress so far onto the base item itself, without consuming or producing anything. Right-clicking that exact base item again later (by you or someone else) picks up right where you left off -- lets a weapon be crafted together with other players. Takes real time, and can be aborted before it finishes.
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_FindRecipesForProcedure: Search the recipe list for every recipe that needs this exact procedure.
IGUI_TWA_ResumingItem: Unfinished recipe bookmarked on this item
IGUI_TWA_MG_Hint: Hold the left mouse button to move the needle, release it inside a zone.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Hint2: Smaller zone = better quality. Outside every zone, past the end or Cancel = Miss.
IGUI_TWA_BaseOnlyBookmarked: Only bookmarked copies - right-click one to resume it
IGUI_TWA_MG_Strike_Hint: Put the hammer on the lit mark and click as the shrinking ring meets it.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Strike_Hint_nails: Drive every nail home. Bad timing bends the nail.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Strike_Hint_rivet: Set every rivet flat. Off-target blows mark the metal.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Strike_Hint_forge: Strike while it glows. Cold metal cracks - hold the hammer on the coals to reheat.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Strike_Hint_knap: Strike the edge at each mark to flake it off cleanly.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Stroke_Hint: Pick the tool up at the gold ring and draw it along the guide, inside the lines.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Stroke_Hint_sharpen: Quick flicks, heel to tip - 10 of them. A slow stroke costs quality and doesn't count.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Stroke_Hint_polish: Quick flicks along the metal - 10 of them. A slow stroke costs quality and doesn't count.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Stroke_Hint_carve: Shave along the stick, one pass at a time.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Stroke_Hint_saw: Back and forth without lifting - each pass cuts deeper.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Stroke_Hint_weld: One slow pass along the seam. Too fast leaves gaps, too slow burns through.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Stroke_Hint_engrave: Follow the pattern slowly and precisely.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Wrap_Hint: Hold the button and circle round the work along the ring, the way the arrows run.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Wrap_Hint_wrap: Each full turn lays one wrap. Too close is too tight, too far is slack.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Wrap_Hint_screw: Turn until the gauge reaches the gold mark, then let go - past the red line the thread strips.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Coat_Hint: Click the pot to load up, then hold and spread it over the dashed area.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Coat_Hint2: Outside the area is wasted; scrubbing fast leaves it uneven.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Coat_Hint_fire: Hold the flame over the dashed area until every spot chars.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Coat_Hint2_fire: Keep moving - too long in one place burns it black.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Heat_Hint: Hold the button to work the bellows; release to let it cool.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Heat_Hint_cool: Hold the button to plunge it into the water; release to lift it out.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Heat_Hint2: Keep the needle in the green band until the meter at the top fills.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Heat_Brittle: Cooling too fast - it'll go brittle!
IGUI_TWA_MG_Pour_Hint: Hold the button to tip the crucible - the longer you hold, the faster it pours.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Pour_Hint2: Let go early - metal still runs after. Fill to the gold line.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Pour_ColdJoin: A second pour leaves a cold join
IGUI_TWA_MG_Pour_Short: Not full yet - pour a little more
IGUI_TWA_MG_Wrap_Hint_grind: Crank the grindstone round at a steady pace - keep the needle in the green.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Wrap_GrindSlow: Too slow - the stone isn't biting
IGUI_TWA_MG_Wrap_GrindFast: Too fast - the steel is overheating
IGUI_TWA_MG_Heat_Hint_bend: Hold the button to bend the branch over your knee; release to ease off.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Heat_Hint2_bend: Hold it in the green band until it snaps cleanly.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Suture_Hint: Pick the needle up at the gold ring and follow the dashed arc: in at the top hole, out at the bottom.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Suture_Hint2: Then hold and pull the thread away until the gauge is in the green, and let go.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Suture_Slipped: The needle slipped out - start the stitch again
IGUI_TWA_MG_Suture_Tore: Pulled too hard - it cut in!
IGUI_TWA_MG_Extract_Hint: Put the bit on the gold mark, hold and draw it straight DOWN to the red line.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Extract_Hint2: Then, still holding, draw it back UP out of the hole - straight and slow.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Extract_TakeBit: Take hold of the bit again.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Extract_Jammed: Let go - the bit is jammed in the hole
IGUI_TWA_MG_Extract_Snapped: Leaned too far - it snapped out!
IGUI_TWA_MG_Extract_NowOut: Deep enough - draw it back out
IGUI_TWA_MG_Incision_Hint: Hold and draw the blade along the guide from the gold mark.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Incision_Hint_carve: Slow cuts deep, fast skims - keep the depth needle in the green. Several passes.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Incision_Hint_engrave: Slow cuts deep, fast skims - keep the depth needle in the green along the whole pattern.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Incision_Lifted: Lifted mid-cut - that pass is lost
IGUI_TWA_MG_Incision_Deep: Too deep - go a bit faster
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_StartCraft: Start this recipe: the base material and the supplementary material are taken right away, and the window stays on this recipe until you Cancel, leave it Incomplete or Finish. Closing the window before it is finished counts as Incomplete.
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_CancelStarted: Cancel this craft: the base material (the original one, even when resuming an unfinished item) and the supplementary material are given back and every procedure done so far is dropped (materials already used by procedures are not refunded).
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_IncompleteStarted: Stop for now: you get the item itself, UNFINISHED -- its damage is 0 until the craft is finished -- with the progress saved on it, and the supplementary material back. Right-click the unfinished item later (you or someone else) to carry on. Closing the window does the same.
IGUI_TWA_StartFirst: Press Start in the middle panel first
IGUI_TWA_LockedToRecipe: A craft is in progress - Cancel it (or leave it Incomplete) to switch recipe
IGUI_TWA_BusyCantClose: Wait for the current action to finish (or stop it) first
IGUI_TWA_ResumeItemNote: Unfinished item - carrying on from it
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_Unfinished: UNFINISHED - damage 0 until the craft is finished (right-click to carry on)
IGUI_TWA_MaterialFinishRule: Materials: Finish needs an overall quality of Good or Excellent - redo weak procedures first.
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_FinishMaterial: Finish the material. Every procedure must be done AND the overall quality must be Good or Excellent; at Bad, redo the weak procedures to raise it. The material itself carries no quality or grade.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Suture_TakeThread: Take the thread at the gold ring on the hole
IGUI_TWA_Debug_NoteMP: Multiplayer: applied on the server and mirrored back to you. Kept on the item and re-applied every hit.
IGUI_TWA_Debug_NoteSP: Kept on the item and re-applied on equip, on load and right before every hit.
IGUI_TWA_Reveal_Hint: The smith brings the piece to life...
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_Practice: Play this procedure's minigame just to practise: no materials, no XP, nothing crafted.
IGUI_TWA_PracticeOff: Minigames are off in this game's sandbox settings
IGUI_TWA_MG_Extract_Hint_drive: Drive each screw in: hold on the screw and draw it DOWN to the red line.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Extract_Hint2_drive: Straight and steady -- leaning or rushing strips it.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Inspect_Hint_select: Look over each tray with the loupe and click the CLEANEST stone.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Inspect_Hint2_select: Flaws only show under the loupe. Two trays.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Inspect_Hint_analyze: Sweep the loupe over the stone and click every inclusion or crack.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Inspect_Hint2_analyze: A click on clean stone is a false call and costs quality.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Inspect_Hint_qc: Final check: find every flaw on the finished gem.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Inspect_Hint2_qc: Smaller loupe, smaller flaws, less time.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Inspect_Hint_plan: Move the cut outline over the rough stone and click to place it.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Inspect_Hint2_plan: Keep all of it inside the stone and as few flaws inside it as you can.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Inspect_OutOfStone: Part of the cut is outside the stone.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Facet_Hint: Hold the button and move the mouse up/down: keep the angle needle in the green band.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Facet_Hint2: The band drifts. Each facet cuts while you hold it right. 8 facets.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Facet_Hint2_fine: The band drifts faster and is narrower. 12 facets.
IGUI_TWA_MG_Strike_Hint_crack: Three well-timed blows to crack the stone open.
IGUI_TWA_GemFinishRule: Finish rolls what the stone held. Chance of a gem (the diamond the rarest) by overall quality: Excellent %1, Good %2, Bad %3 in 100; otherwise clay, scrap metal, limestone, charcoal, coke or dung.
IGUI_TWA_Tooltip_FinishGem: Crack the stone open and see what it held. No grade: what you get is rolled when you finish.
IGUI_TWA_GemReveal_Hint: The stone cracks... the light inside flickers through...
IGUI_TWA_GemReveal_Lost: Nothing came out of the stone.
IGUI_TWA_Socket_NoSlots: Grade F: this weapon has no sockets.
IGUI_TWA_Socket_RuleNormal2: A gem set here can't be taken out; a new gem can replace it and the old one is lost.
IGUI_TWA_Socket_RuleSpecial2: Grade S only. Its gem can be taken out again or swapped.
IGUI_TWA_Socket_Hint2: Only weapons with a grade from this mod's crafting
IGUI_TWA_Socket_Gone: The weapon is no longer in your inventory.
IGUI_TWA_Socket_PermanentWarn: This socket is permanent: the gem can't be taken out again.
IGUI_TWA_Socket_ReplaceWarn: The gem already in this socket will be LOST when replaced.
IGUI_TWA_GemRefineRule: The base is any gem in the state %1. Finish gives back the same gem one state up; it can break by overall quality: Bad %2, Good %3, Excellent %4 in 100.
IGUI_TWA_BaseNeedsState: Needs a gem in the state: %1
IGUI_TWA_ChooseBase: Click to choose which one to use
IGUI_TWA_GemBreak_Hint: Too rough a hand: it cracked apart.
